itemized.notes: 2006 form, handwritten, June 20 interim box checked (period ending 2006-06-19), signed 6/20/06, clerk RECEIVED JUN 20 2006. Addresses here are NOT redacted - they are written out - so only CITY and STATE were taken from each and the street/PO line was discarded at read time. In-kind: the 606.56 Interform Graphics item is booked on BOTH schedules (Schedule A row 4, marked 'Inkind' in the amount cell; Schedule B row 8, marked 'Inkind' inside the purpose cell) and both printed totals include it - that is how this filer presented it, not a transcription duplication. Occupation/Employer values on Schedule A are informative (Candidate, Small Business Owner/mechanic, Print, Event Managment/Utah Grizzlies, Law Firm, Sports Managment) but the per-row contract has no slot for them.
